anomaly_definitions.person_running: A person moves much faster than the normal walkway baseline.
anomaly_definitions.person_jumping: A person performs abrupt vertical motion or jumps in the walkway scene.
anomaly_definitions.person_falling_or_lying: A person falls, lies down, or remains in a low/horizontal state.
anomaly_definitions.person_loitering_or_wrong_direction: A person stays unusually long, wanders, or moves against the dominant walkway flow.
anomaly_definitions.person_object_throwing: A person throws an object or shows a clear throwing-like interaction.
anomaly_definitions.person_abnormal_object_interaction: A person carries, drops, picks, or manipulates an abnormal visible object.
anomaly_definitions.bicycle_intrusion_or_abnormal_ride: A bicycle appears or moves abnormally in the Avenue walkway scene.
anomaly_definitions.object_throwing: A thrown object is visible or inferable from person-object motion.
anomaly_definitions.abnormal_object: A visible object appears abnormal for the walkway scene, even when its exact class is weak.
